mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a comfortable 72 degrees with clear skies observed at Verona Area High School and a lovely waxing crescent moon.

The City of Verona has announced that road construction along Highway M is scheduled to begin next Tuesday, August 18, which will involve lane shifts and utility work. Also, the Senior Center is inviting residents to volunteer to support their vital community services.

There is plenty to do this week. Today, you can check out the User Group Meeting at Epic Systems or join the yoga class at Insight Wellness. Looking toward tomorrow, we have trivia nights at Hop Haus Brewing and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly report, we noted an incident from Wednesday, August 5, where officers were dispatched to the 500 block of Whalen Road to locate and arrest an individual with an outstanding warrant.
Today, you can enjoy the delicious Caramel Peanut Buttercup flavor of the day. The store is open until 10 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
